answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of identities for a live audit: the chosen agent must answer a compute heartbeat in ten minutes, proving work from its basalt log. A farm with 1,000 fakes expects 50 audits per epoch, and each miss burns a 20 POA deposit, so the farm bleeds 1,000 POA per epoch. An honest agent posts one 20 POA deposit and passes by doing normal work; the seed is published on the jetty, and the nectar pool pays survivors.
